title: calystegia sepium var. hantelmannii
intro: Calystegia sepium var. hantelmannii, commonly known as Hedge Bindweed, is a perennial climber or twiner of the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its use in treating various digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calystegia sepium var. hantelmannii include soothing the mucous membranes and providing relief from gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, although specific research on these constituents is limited, indicating a need for further scientific study.
